Hello, StoopNet

This page is compiled from md/hello.md at build time. The front matter above gives the document its title, and type: guide becomes a class on the <body> element.

What the compiler does

  • Renders markdown (headings, lists, code, quotes) to HTML
  • Links the shared stylesheet and script: /index.css and /index.js
  • Maps the type front matter key to a class on <body>

Linking pages

Wikilinks point at other compiled pages: back to this page links here, while [[other-page|a friendly name]] would link to other-page.html (just [[other-page]] uses the page name as the link text).

Styling this page

The shared stylesheet applies everywhere. Page-specific styling can target the body class:

body.guide {
  /* guide-specific styles */
}
